scope: One instrumented cold launch per arm; no upgrade-path or causal-speedup claim.

post_completion_observation.reason: No HANDOFF_COMPLETE. Post-completion observations are not applicable; empty arrays are not zero latency.

coverage.boundary: A closed stream and event endpoints do not prove a buffer never filled or every category was active. RECORD_UNTIL_FULL, incomplete spans, redacted metadata and external parser warnings must remain visible. Absence is not exclusion.

nesting.boundary: Timestamp-based nesting is descriptive. Crossing/equal spans make self-wall attribution ambiguous. Recorded self wall is not CPU time; no sum of inclusive parent and child durations is a valid total.

alignment.transform: internal ts in microseconds * 1000 + supplied offset
alignment.boundary: System windows are supplied externally. Stripped clock metadata cannot independently establish exact synchronization; compare observer anchors and common events/source clock before attributing exact edges.

alignment_evidence.interpretation: External MONOTONIC and BOOTTIME snapshots share an epoch within their sampling skew. Mapping Chromium event timestamps assumes its Android TimeTicks MONOTONIC source; this is source-based inference, not measured exact synchronization. Same-name external HWUI and internal WebView shader events are different operations and do not supply a shared marker.

redaction.boundary: Stripped args cannot identify a sync token, mailbox, resource, program key, or their ownership.
